name: Saltstripe
summary: A striped-shirt summer shop with an ad-film hero, size finder, stories, checkout and owner admin
about: A complete seaside clothing store whose home page plays like a five-scene commercial, with stories, reviews, a filterable shop, product pages, a bag, checkout and a PIN-locked admin. A size finder turns height, weight and fit preference into a measured size suggestion. Admin edits to stock, prices, visibility and reviews change the store straight away.
how: Watch the ad film on the home page; pause it, skip scenes or tap a progress segment, then tap Shop the summer drop.
Filter shirts by category, fit, stripe, colour, size in stock and price, and sort them; cards re-flow with a spring.
On a product, pick a colour (the shirt re-dyes), choose a size or use Find my size, then Add to bag and watch it fly into the bag.
Open the bag to change quantities, remove lines, apply the code SAILOR20 and check out with cash on delivery, card, bank transfer or mobile wallet.
Open Admin with the demo PIN 2468 to see KPIs and the sales chart, change order status, edit stock and prices, and approve reviews.
Tap a story bubble to watch customer and lookbook stories; arrow keys skip and Escape closes.
